question: What does the simplest P0596 consensus law do when one fixed formula is replayed on every galaxy, cluster map, Lenstool realization, GLAFIC map, and the finite-source Solar audit?
selection_disclosure: The settings are a post-hoc simplification of P0596: q and f are its common fold boundaries, C0=0.6 and w=0.1 are the central recurring gate, and the weak acceleration gate is removed. No result here is a fresh formula holdout.
claim_limits: The formula was simplified after inspecting P0596 and is not independently selected or validated.
The galaxy scalar response remains empirical RAR; this experiment tests whether one conservative spatial layer adds transferable information.
Cluster scores use normalized morphology and do not test absolute convergence amplitude.
The cluster baryon proxy omits hot gas, ICL, and stellar mass-to-light variation.
The Solar calculation uses spherical shell-theorem and finite-source-tail controls, not a covariant PPN metric or stellar-interior test.
